about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for circ-adb-2024 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The Annex A heading, the 'Building Act 1984' heading and the whole withdrawal notice box are read as running text inside paragraph 12 under ENQUIRIES, not as their own annex section.
findings.evidence: tree: "buildingassurance@communities.gov.uk Signed: John Palmer ANNEX A –Withdrawal of Notices Building Act 1984 NOTICE OF THE WITHDRAWAL OF NOTICES"

findings.problem: Paragraph 12 also runs on into the Annex C notice of withdrawal, skipping Annex B, so a different annex's rule sits under the same paragraph.
findings.evidence: tree: "2 September 2024 ANNEX C – Notice of Withdrawal Building Act 1984 NOTICE OF WITHDRAWAL OF APPROVAL"

findings.problem: The signature block printed as a two-column table is flattened into running text.
findings.evidence: source: "Signed by authority of the Secretary of State | J. Palmer" / tree: "Signed by authority of the Secretary of State J. Palmer An Assistant Secretary"

findings.problem: The annex heading 'ANNEX A –Withdrawal of Notices' is kept as body text at the end of paragraph 12 under ENQUIRIES instead of as a heading over the notice.
findings.evidence: source: "ANNEX A –Withdrawal of Notices" (heading) / tree: "Signed: John Palmer ANNEX A –Withdrawal of Notices"

findings.problem: The Annex B notice of approval table is titled and filed under ENQUIRIES instead of under 'ANNEX B – Notice of Approval', which survives only inside the table text.
findings.evidence: source: "ANNEX B – Notice of Approval" / tree: "title": "ENQUIRIES", "heading_path": "ENQUIRIES > ENQUIRIES"

findings.problem: The headings 'Building Act 1984' and the notice title are not kept as headings; they appear only as lines in the table text.
findings.evidence: tree text: "Building Act 1984", "ANNEX B – Notice of Approval", "NOTICE OF APPROVAL OF REVISION OF DOCUMENTS GIVING PRACTICAL"

findings.problem: The table's full-width title row and preamble row (including the effective dates) are kept only in the table text, not as rows of the grid.
findings.evidence: source: "The approval takes effect on 2 March 2025 except in respect of work..." / tree: grid starts at "Approved Document B (Fire safety) volume 1"

findings.problem: The Annex A notice of approval table has ENQUIRIES as its parent, so the annex sits under the enquiries section rather than as its own section.
findings.evidence: tree: "heading_path": "ENQUIRIES > ANNEX A – Notice of Approval"

findings.problem: A word is split by a space in the table text.
findings.evidence: source: "made before that date" / tree: "m ade before that date"

findings.problem: ANNEX A is placed under the ENQUIRIES heading in the heading path, though it is a separate annex.
findings.evidence: tree: "ENQUIRIES > ANNEX A – Notice of Approval"

findings.problem: A word is split in the table text.
findings.evidence: source: "made before that date" / tree: "m ade before that date"

findings.problem: The table's full-width title row and preamble row (including the effective dates) are kept only in the table text, not as rows of the grid.
findings.evidence: source: "The revisions take effect on 2 September 2029..." / tree: grid starts at "Approved Document B (Fire safety) volume 1"
